scope_label: structured guide for evaluating specified work or performance
definition: A rubric is a structured guide for judging a specified kind of work or performance against stated criteria.
explanation: It may describe levels of performance, give examples, assign points, or set out scoring rules. These details help reviewers apply the criteria and make the basis of a judgment visible.

A rubric organizes judgment; it does not establish that the criteria are appropriate or that different reviewers will apply them consistently. Those questions require separate justification and checking.
